_comment: Adjudicated skill-intent registry (S3, design docs/designs/2026-11-26-skill-drift-structural-fixes-design.md §4.3). Records capability@project pairs whose difference from the template majority is INTENTIONAL per a recorded decision — classifyConvergence reports them converged-intent instead of divergence. L0-only: never propagated, no delivery-map entry, lib/fleet.ts never parses this file (membership and intent are different domains). LOCAL-PATCH markers are NOT intent: a marker records 'do not overwrite' (the engine's markerLossBlocks), a row records 'adjudicated intentional'; the mechanisms stack — a registry row never weakens marker loss, and a marker without a row keeps surfacing in the weekly report. Validation is fail-closed (lib/fleet.ts precedent): malformed schema, unknown kind, bad decision_ref, non-fleet project, or a capability absent from that project's graph aborts the fleet report naming the row. A row whose pair later re-converges is inert documentation. Dispositions: docs/reports/2026-11-26-skill-drift-adjudication.md (T-20261123-005).

entries.reason: Scoping hand ruling entry #1 of the T-20261123-005 skill-graph divergence ticket: co-price intentionally carries a scoped i18n-audit adaptation (ja-market localization review) that must not converge to the common form; the earlier exclusion was a hand ruling in a ticket, this row makes it a mechanism.

Co-design design-stack hub promotion (2026-11-01, commit b90c28e50, PR #1799 under the hub-consolidation design): the co-design copy is the promoted hub asset (1.3.0) that the common skill (1.1.1) lags; the promotion direction is hub-to-common, so the pair difference is the mechanism working, not drift.

Same co-design design-stack hub promotion batch as design-foundation (2026-11-01, commit b90c28e50): co-design carries the promoted override 1.1.1 while common sits at 1.1.0; intentional until the next common promotion.

Registered co-safety variant override (templates/co-safety/skills/project-review/, 1.3.4 vs common 1.3.2): the model case of an override that exists in the template tree and needs report awareness only — adjudication row 11 KEEP_PROJECT.

Registered co-safety variant override (templates/co-safety/skills/skill-lifecycle-manager/, 1.5.1 vs common 1.5.0 — separate lanes, so the versions legitimately coexist); adjudication row 20 KEEP_PROJECT.

Registered LOCAL-PATCH(upstream-request: UR-2) per ADR-0097 — L3-detached-project battery instructions (17 project-only lines, 4 template-only) on top of a project-ahead version pin 1.3.3 > template 1.3.2; markerLossBlocks already protects the bytes, this row stops the weekly re-surfacing. Adjudication row 10 KEEP_PROJECT. UR-2 predates the current ticket-id scheme (legacy upstream-request id, not in any ticket store).

Three-line deliverables-convention redirect (docs/reports/ -> deliverables/reports/, commit a8f7482, 2026-11-05) per co-work's deliverables layout; pair-program row P4 lands the templates/co-work/skills/project-review/ override so the pair converges with delivery intact — the row is valid on registration (the capability exists in co-work's graph) and inert once the override converges the pair. Adjudication row 12.
